name: Slide-Up Elementor Button Animation – Jixart
author: Jixart

sections.description: Automatically enhances Elementor buttons with animated text hover effects. Preserves icon layout, inherits theme colors, and requires no manual configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Will this change button colors?

No, it uses inherited colors from your existing button styles.

Will it affect icon positioning?

No, icons remain in their original positions.
